review.notes: Reviewed the finite route, passport conditions, entry/transit exceptions and available evidence against the cited official sources. See docs/content-review-networks-2026-11-03.md. This is an agent source review, not independent human or immigration-authority approval.

assumptions: All passengers and documents are synthetic. Travel begins on 2026-11-03; connections arrive at the hub on 2026-11-04. Flight clocks are invented for this puzzle, not a live timetable. All unmentioned identity, security, funds, return/onward bookings, health and departure checks are stipulated satisfied. Only the documents and facts shown or obtainable through the offered checks are available. Unless expressly identified, the traveller has an ordinary passport, no additional citizenship, no destination residence, special passport, crew, e-Channel or other exemption. Short tourism only; no work. Routine entry permissions for an untested leg are not silently assumed when that leg is part of the puzzle.

Air Beluga training procedure (fictional carrier policy): complete the offered checks. Escalate a material eligibility, identity or transfer conflict that remains unresolved after those checks; deny a confirmed requirement failure once relevant obtainable alternatives are excluded. Unfamiliarity alone is insufficient. No live airline or government systems are called.
Singapore hub arrival is 2026-11-04T08:00:00+08:00. Where a Japanese visa is shown it is an unused sticker visa for the onward tourism visit. No used single-journey-visa return to India is involved.

The traveller is a qualifying UK resident for eVISA application. Singapore airside handling is confirmed. The live notice has a different holder surname despite the same passport number; no alternative Japanese visa or exemption is available.
